SI06: Monthly releases, monitoring and logs [monthly]
sections: We would deliver this with AEM Sites.
We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.

We will work through Adobe's go-live checklist: a production pipeline with functional and UI tests, Dispatcher validation, CDN, SSL and DNS, performance and security tests on stage, notification profiles and traffic filter rules.
Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.
draft.plain:
Our approach
- We would deliver this with AEM Sites.

What we would do
- We will assign AEM product profiles in the Admin Console, create the production program and environments in Cloud Manager, set up Git access and the first deployment pipelines.
- We will build the site from the AEM Project Archetype or a Site Template, with Core Components, editable templates, client-side libraries and the custom components the design needs.
- We will work through Adobe's go-live checklist: a production pipeline with functional and UI tests, Dispatcher validation, CDN, SSL and DNS, performance and security tests on stage, notification profiles and traffic filter rules.

After launch
- Each month we will ship code through Cloud Manager pipelines, check the automatic AEM version updates, review logs and the Developer Console, and fix issues found after go-live.

Sources
- Experience League: AEM as a Cloud Service Onboarding Journey Introduction: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/onboarding/journey/overview
- Experience League: Get started with AEM Sites - WKND tutorial: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-learn/getting-started-wknd-tutorial-develop/overview
- Experience League: Post Go-Live: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/migration-journey/post-go-live
- Go-Live Checklist: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/onboarding/journey/go-live-checklist
- AEM Version Updates: https://experienceleague.adobe.com/en/docs/experience-manager-cloud-service/content/implementing/deploying/aem-version-updates
